summary.name: Keyzer
summary.one_liner: Keyzer is a native Mac password manager that encrypts passwords and other private information into a portable Keyzer file.
use_cases: Storing passwords securely on a Mac
Keeping credit card and bank details private
Saving sensitive data in a portable encrypted file
summary.what_it_does: Keyzer is a native macOS app for storing passwords and other private information such as credit card details and bank account information. It encrypts this data and saves it into a portable Keyzer file. The page lists a free download with in-app purchases, including an All Access Monthly plan at $1.99 and an All Access Lifetime plan at $3.99. The developer states it does not collect any data from the app. Localization covers English and eight other languages.
